question: Galaxies' extra pull appears where acceleration falls below 1.2 × 10⁻¹⁰ m/s². At that rate, how many years to reach 1 m/s from rest?
move: Tests in strong conditions say nothing about how things behave when faint.
trap: Expecting a flaw in the law of gravity to show up in a laboratory.
hint: Divide the speed by the acceleration, then turn the seconds into years.
source: McGaugh, Lelli & Schombert, Physical Review Letters, 2016
reference: McGaugh, Lelli & Schombert, Radial Acceleration Relation in Rotationally Supported Galaxies, Physical Review Letters 117, 201101, 2016
